01

“Alif Lam Mim. Do the people think they will be left to say 'We…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:1, 29:2).

757
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 757: 1: 3

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
757: 1:3. Sufyan, from Abu Hashim, from Mujahid, on His words
"Alif Lam Mim. Do the people think they will be left to say 'We believe' and not be tried?": He said, they are tested; "We tried those before them": he said, We tested (verses 1, 2).
العربية
757: 1: 3 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ الم أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوا أَنْ يَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وهم لا يفتنون قال يبتلون فتنا الذين من قبلهم قال ابتلينا (الآية 1 و 2) .

02

“the remembrance of God is greater [akbar]”

An explanation transmitted from Abd Allah ibn Rabia (Q 29:45).

758
Explanation from Abd Allah ibn Rabia No. 758: 2: 1

Abd Allah ibn Rabia

English
Transmission wording
758: 2:1. Sufyan, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Abd Allah ibn Rabia, who said:
Ibn Abbas asked me about the words of God "the remembrance of God is greater [akbar]." I said, "The takbir, the tahlil, and the tahmid." Ibn Abbas said, "God's remembrance of you is greater than your remembrance of Him" (verse 45).
العربية
758: 2: 1 سفيان عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّايِبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ قَالَ سألني بن عباس في قوله الله اكبر فَقُلْتُ التَّكْبِيرُ وَالتَّهْلِيلُ وَالتَّحْمِيدُ فَقَالَ بن عَبَّاسٍ فَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ إِيَّاكُمْ أَكْبَرُ من ذكركم إياه (الآية 45) .

03

“And do not argue with the People of the Book except in the best way…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 29:46).

759
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 759: 3: 2

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
759: 3:2. Sufyan, from Khusayf, from Mujahid:
"And do not argue with the People of the Book except in the best way, except for those who wrong among them": He said, do not argue and do not fight, except those who fight you ⦗p. 236⦘ and have not paid the jizya (verse 46).
العربية
759: 3: 2 سفيان عن خصيف عن مجاهد تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِلا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا منهم قَالَ وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا وَلَا تُقَاتِلُوا إِلَّا مَنْ قَاتَلَكُمْ ⦗p. 236⦘ ولم يعط الجزية (الآية 46) .

04

“My servants who believe, My earth is spacious”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 29:56).

760
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 760: 4: 3

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
760: 4:3. Sufyan, from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words
"My servants who believe, My earth is spacious": He said, if sins are committed in it, then leave it (verse 56).
العربية
760: 4: 3 سفيان عن اسمعيل بن أبي خلد عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي قوله عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ أَرْضِي واسعة فَإِذَا عُمِلَ فِيهَا بِالْمَعَاصِي فَاخْرُجُوا (الآية 56) .
